config.label: Xentropy API base URL
config.description: Xentropy API base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:3001/api. Must include the /api prefix.

config.label: API token (Supabase access JWT) for static authentication
config.description: API token (Supabase access JWT) for static authentication. Obtain via 'xen-notes-mcp login --email YOU --password X --show-token'.

config.label: Refresh token for automatic token rotation
config.description: Refresh token for automatic token rotation. Only needed if using static token auth without interactive login.
